name: 灯塔信标 / Island Beacon
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single polished macOS application icon design candidate for "Agent Island", a quiet native desktop panel that gathers the status of multiple AI coding sessions.
Output: one square 1024x1024 image, one icon only. Genuinely transparent outside the icon's rounded-square tile. Center the tile at about 84 percent of the canvas width, with generous equal transparent margins, front-facing orthographic composition. All artwork stays within the tile. Refined macOS-quality materials and very controlled subtle depth. Highly legible, bold coherent silhouette at 32 pixels, no tiny details. Excellent visual balance and optical centering.
Constraints: no words, no letters except any explicitly requested terminal symbol, no labels, no watermark, no brand logos, no device mockup, no surrounding scenery, no design board, no alternate views. Use softly continuous corners.
Primary request: "Island beacon" — a deep inky blue rounded-square tile (#15232F). One minimalist sculptural ivory lighthouse on a small low mint-green island plinth, centered and bold. Lighthouse is a single simple tapered column with a wide dark window near its rounded top and a simple cap, no brick details, no door, no stripes. A small warm amber light (#F1CC82) glows inside the top window; two short broad soft amber wedges radiate to left and right, entirely within the tile, acting as calm signals. Low island base is one thick smooth oval pill in muted mint (#ADD6BA), not a landscape. The lighthouse plus island must read as one strong compact silhouette at small size. Refined restrained dimensional ceramic illustration, crisp silhouette, gentle highlights. No ocean, no sky, no stars, no clouds, no realistic landscape, no excessive bloom. Quiet reassuring status beacon for coding agents. Main symbol takes 62 percent of tile width and height.
